title: Lavish resort in "Paradise" with three large pools
content: Year's ago I had a dream about a large,lavish resort hotel with large swimming pools. At least three of them with one large one near the main hotel room. It seemed there were small cottages/cabins or time share type lodging at the edge of the property. It seemed to be a large,lavish resort in a "Paradise" location like Puerto Vallarta Mexico. There seemed to be hilly, terrain near the resort and maybe mountains in the distant. The resort was along the ocean along a "curved" moon shaped bay with a long sandy beach. I belive I was "vacationing" there and may have stayed there a few days there in the dream. During the day the pool area was always hopping with lots of people in and around the pools but at night it was much more quiet. Something weird happened if you got to the edge of the property. Suddenly these bungalow cottages appears. I think there was a "hermit" living in one and maybe a strange woman who may have been a "witch" in another. I dreamt of this more than once but haven't been there in years.
